name: gateway_sneak_unblockable_only_this_turn
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever a Gate you control enters, this creature can't be blocked this turn.' Seat 0 plays Azorius Guildgate on turn 1 and does not attack. On seat 0's next turn (turn 3) Gateway Sneak attacks with no Gate entering that turn: Opp Bear is offered the block and takes it ('this turn' ended with turn 1). The Sneak (1/3) survives the Bear and deals no damage to seat 1.
